answer_1.quote: We employ three datasets, including TL;DR, UltraFeedback-P (UF-P), that explicitly capture diverse user preferences... TL;DR dataset contains Reddit posts alongside concise summaries... PersonalLLM is built with 10,402 open-ended prompts... For each prompt, they used eight frontier chat models to generate a diverse response set...

answer_2.quote: We report reward model accuracy on unseen test pairs that are not in the survey set... accuracy is calculated over all seen users.
